content.text: In regions facing severe restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal, digital creators often struggle to set up their online stores efficiently. This guide presents a step-by-step deployment strategy using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-6|COREMERCH guide to supabase]]-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-7|supabase]] as your order database, ensuring seamless crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-first-principles-definitive-2|Payment Infrastructure]] processing without reliance on conventional payment systems. With Stack 01 taking just 4-6 hours to deploy, you can quickly establish a fully operational digital store that caters to your unique needs. Let’s dive into how you can leverage this robust infrastructure to reclaim your financial sovereignty.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in regions like Nigeria or Venezuela, leaving them without viable options for monetization. By using a stack that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, you create a resilient architecture that operates independently of these platforms. This infrastructure allows you to accept crypto payments directly, mitigating the risks of platform restrictions or failures. You own the entire process, eliminating dependency on third-party services that may hinder your operations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting your deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account to host your static site. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic, as this will handle order processing. You’ll also need a NOWPayments account to manage crypto transactions. Collect your product files and prepare descriptions, as you will load these into your store. This pre-deployment setup is crucial for a smooth launch and operational efficiency.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your GitHub Pages site, embedding your product files and details. Next, configure Google Apps Script to handle incoming orders and orchestrate communication with NOWPayments for payment processing. This involves writing scripts that verify payments and trigger file delivery upon confirmation. Testing this pipeline ensures that your customers receive their products instantly after payment, establishing trust and reliability in your digital store.
Reclaim your financial sovereignty with your own digital store architecture.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Share your store link widely, directing traffic to your GitHub Pages site. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything functions as expected. Utilize NOWPayments' webhook capabilities to handle payment confirmations seamlessly. By processing your first transaction successfully, you validate your infrastructure and can confidently promote your store to a broader audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, consider how to scale effectively. You can expand your product range by adding more items to your GitHub Pages site and updating your Google Apps Script accordingly. Leverage Supabase for enhanced order management, allowing for better tracking and analytics. As your sales grow, you may explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to upgrade your infrastructure, providing additional features without switching platforms.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Leverage robust infrastructure to bypass traditional payment platform restrictions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're exploring hosting options, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a more sophisticated setup that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. This stack streamlines your deployment while maintaining the sovereignty of your digital commerce. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?
Use GitHub Pages for hosting your store and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to maintain full control and ownership over your sales process.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store, offering a reliable platform for you to manage your digital sales.
What are the benefits of using Supabase as my order database?
Supabase provides a powerful and scalable solution for managing orders, enabling you to track sales efficiently while ensuring data ownership and security.
How does NOWPayments work for crypto transactions?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. It verifies payments automatically through webhooks, ensuring prompt delivery of digital products.
Experience instant product delivery with automated crypto payment processing.
